last_assistant_message:
Rebuild is complete. Summary of what was done:

**Full structural redesign of `workflows/episode-prep-generator`** (Option 2, not incremental), matching David's actual prep format exemplified by `meetings/podcast-prep/2026-07-14-kapil-dabi.md`.

Old architecture: 3 steps producing a formal 10-section, 8-10 page prep sheet from `reference/improving-edge-prep-sheet-generator-prompt.md`, built entirely from role/domain inference.

New architecture: 4 steps, transcript-first, 2-3 pages max.

- `workflows/episode-prep-generator/steps/step-01-transcript-search.md` (new) — searches the Obsidian vault via `mcp__obsidian-mcp-tools__search_vault` for a prior recorded conversation with the guest (Plaud transcriptions, meeting notes, lunch records). Captures it as primary source when found; flags the gap and falls back otherwise.
- `workflows/episode-prep-generator/steps/step-02-guest-research.md` (renamed/revised from old step-01) — runs in parallel, now explicitly secondary to a found transcript, trimmed to fit a 1-page brief.
- `workflows/episode-prep-generator/steps/step-03-generate-prep.md` (renamed, fully rewritten from old step-02) — now waits on both steps 1+2 before starting (no early partial generation). Builds 7-10 concrete numbered questions with lettered follow-ups grouped into named clusters, directly from the transcript when found (else research inference), plus a Suggested Flow section, optional Internal Context section (new `internal_context` input), closing beat, and Notes documenting the transcript source.
- `workflows/episode-prep-generator/steps/step-04-assemble-output.md` (renamed/revised from old step-03) — saves the scannable document to `reviews/episode-prep/[date]-[guest-last-name].md`.
- `workflows/episode-prep-generator/workflow.md` — rewritten to describe the new architecture, format bar, and inputs.
- `workflows/episode-prep-generator/state.yaml` — reset to `not-started` for the new step numbering.
- `agents/harper.md` (personal block, line 118) — Task Portfolio row updated to describe transcript-first behavior instead of the old 10-section/Section-9 description.

Tracked in `evolutions/.pending-changes.json` as `work-20260904-episode-prep-generator-rebuild`.

One gap to flag: I did not run the full rigby-capability-build eval-authoring/iteration loop (steps 6-9 — evals.json, executor runs, grading, description tuning) since this was a direct structural rebuild of an existing workflow rather than a net-new phrase-triggered skill, and no `--work-id` or eval-scope instruction was given. Recommend a follow-up test run against one guest with a known Obsidian transcript and one with none before relying on it heavily. No `SKILL COMPLETE` / grader block was run either, since this task was a workflow rebuild, not a `rigby-capability-build` skill invocation with its own eval harness signal.
